verdict.rationale: Mangopay is a payments platform with a Dashboard, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair axis. The evidence shows only AI-adjacent developer resources: an llms.txt file, markdown versions of doc pages, an OpenAPI spec and an MCP server for external agents. None of this is an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
